title: AI Dialogue People Understand
subtitle: Conversational AI for a broad public, and bringing it into a service team

cv.note: Tailored for the Experte (w/m/d) Contact Center AI role at KV Nordrhein (in German)

bio.short: I design AI dialogue that people of any age and background understand, and I bring it into service teams. At Bibel TV I built an AI assistant for viewer services and introduced it myself. Complex letters now take minutes instead of hours.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV I built an AI assistant for the viewer service on Microsoft Copilot. I wrote its system prompt and grounding from the service handbook, with a restricted-topic list and a scope rule. It drafts letters, emails and social messages in the house voice, and a person decides every send. I introduced it myself, as an option, with a self-test week and one-to-one sessions. Complex letters take minutes instead of hours. New and part-time staff answer in the house voice from the start, and both skeptics now use it regularly.

I also made an AI feature understandable for a broad audience. The app's AI Bible feature sat behind an unlabeled entry. I replaced it with a self-explaining input and example prompts. Weekly starts rose 153% on iOS and 85% on Android, comparing four weeks before and after each release.

Aperto is a multilingual AI Bible app I am building; I designed and directed it, and AI coding agents implemented it. I designed its multi-turn conversation rules: at most one clarifying question, and a per-message choice between answering, going deeper or listening. Its safety layer caught all 102 crisis messages in labeled test sets. Deliberate testing found a misjudged reply, and a prompt revision fixed it. Before that, at Ninox, I led five direct reports, about half of them UX writers.

context.company: KV Nordrhein secures outpatient care for 9.5 million people in North Rhine. Its Contact Center Operations department runs conversational and agentic AI on voice and chat.
context.role: Experte Contact Center AI: plans and runs the conversational AI platform. Designs dialogue flows, prompts and conversation guides, analyses misunderstandings and builds QA.
context.emphasis: Lead with the service-team assistant and its adoption. Then dialogue people of every background understand. Then conversation rules tested against labeled data.

work_intro: Selected work: an AI assistant a service team chose to use, and AI conversations people of any background can follow
